name: Job Board by ejobsitesoftware
author: vikas chawla

sections.description:
Job Board by ejobsitesoftware is a powerful and flexible job board solution for WordPress. It allows you to create a full-featured job portal with:

  • Custom post types for jobs
  • Employer and jobseeker dashboards
  • AJAX-powered job search
  • Resume upload and management
  • Application tracking and admin management
  • Custom taxonomies for job categories and types
  • Shortcodes for easy integration
  • And much more!

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later.

Support

For support, please visit https://ejobsitesoftware.com/contact/ or use the WordPress.org support forums.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/jobboard-plugin directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Use the ‘AYN Job Board’ menu in the WordPress admin to configure the plugin.
sections.faq:
What shortcodes are available?

  • [jobboard_jobs] – Display job listings.
  • [jobboard_post_job] – Show the post job form (for employers).
  • [jobboard_dashboard] – Show the user dashboard.
  • [jobboard_login] – Show the login form.
  • [jobboard_register] – Show the registration form.
  • [employer_dashboard] – Show the employer dashboard.
  • [jobseeker_dashboard] – Show the jobseeker dashboard.
  • [jobboard_apply_form] – Show the job application form.

Can I customize the templates?

Yes, you can override the plugin’s template files in your theme.
